## chemistry

Data from 2007 include only a single storm at IBW; these are omitted owing to
lack of collection times

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: runoff-chemistry-table

runoff_chemistry_query <- glue::glue_sql("
SELECT
  samples.bottle,
  sites.abbreviation AS runoff_location,
  samples.sample_datetime AS runoff_datetime,
  samples.comments AS sample_comments,
  samples.\"lab_pH\" AS pH,
  results.replicate,
  analysis.analysis_name,
  results.concentration AS analysis_concentration,
  dq.data_qualifier_label AS analysis_data_qualifier,
  results.comments AS analysis_comments
FROM
  stormwater.samples
  LEFT JOIN stormwater.results ON (results.sample_id = samples.sample_id)
  JOIN stormwater.analysis ON (results.analysis_id = analysis.analysis_id)
  JOIN stormwater.sites ON (samples.site_id = sites.site_id)
  LEFT JOIN stormwater.data_qualifier dq ON (dq.data_qualifier_id = results.data_qualifier)
WHERE
  EXTRACT (YEAR FROM samples.sample_datetime) > 2007 AND
  -- results.analysis_id IS NOT NULL AND
  (bottle NOT ILIKE '%rain%' OR bottle IS NULL) AND
  sites.abbreviation NOT IN ({snaz_sites*})
;
",
.con = DBI::ANSI()
)

runoff_chemistry <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, runoff_chemistry_query)

runoff_chemistry <- runoff_chemistry |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    blank           = as.factor(ifelse(grepl("blk|blank", bottle, ignore.case = T), "TRUE", "FALSE")),
    runoff_location = as.factor(runoff_location),
    analysis_name   = as.factor(analysis_name),
    replicate       = as.character(replicate)
    ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    runoff_location,
    runoff_datetime,
    blank,
    everything(),
    -bottle
    ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    runoff_location,
    analysis_name,
    runoff_datetime
  )

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(runoff_chemistry, overwrite = FALSE)
  capeml::write_factors(runoff_chemistry, overwrite = FALSE)
})

```


## discharge

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: discharge_query

core_q_query <- glue::glue_sql("
SELECT
  sites.abbreviation AS discharge_location,
  discharge.event_datetime AS discharge_datetime,
  discharge.water_height AS water_height,
  discharge.discharge AS raw_discharge,
  discharge.discharge_corrected AS edited_discharge
FROM
  stormwater.discharge
  JOIN stormwater.sites ON (discharge.site_id = sites.site_id)
WHERE
  sites.abbreviation NOT IN ({snaz_sites*}) AND
  discharge.event_datetime IS NOT NULL
;
",
.con = DBI::ANSI()
)

core_q <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, core_q_query)

lm_sgc_q_query <- glue::glue_sql("
SELECT
  sites.abbreviation AS discharge_location,
  discharge.event_datetime AS discharge_datetime,
  discharge.water_height AS water_height,
  discharge.discharge AS raw_discharge,
  discharge.discharge_corrected AS edited_discharge
FROM
  stormwater.discharge
  JOIN stormwater.sites ON (discharge.site_id = sites.site_id)
WHERE
  sites.abbreviation IN ('SGC', 'LM') AND
  -- (discharge.discharge IS NOT NULL OR discharge.discharge_corrected IS NOT NULL)
  discharge.event_datetime >= '2012-08-24' AND
  discharge.event_datetime IS NOT NULL
;
",
.con = DBI::ANSI()
)

lm_sgc_q <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, lm_sgc_q_query)

discharge <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  core_q,
  lm_sgc_q
  ) |>
dplyr::arrange(
  discharge_location,
  discharge_datetime
  ) |>
dplyr::mutate(
  discharge_location = as.factor(discharge_location)
)

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(discharge, overwrite = FALSE)
  capeml::write_factors(discharge, overwrite = FALSE)
})

```


## particulates

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: particulates_process

particulates_query <- glue::glue_sql("
SELECT
  samples.bottle,
  sites.abbreviation AS runoff_location,
  samples.sample_datetime AS runoff_datetime,
  solids.replicate AS replicate,
  solids.filter_initial AS filter_wt,
  solids.filter_dry AS filter_dry_wt,
  solids.volume_filtered AS vol_filtered,
  solids.filter_ashed AS filter_ash_wt,
  solids.data_qualifier AS data_qualifier,
  solids.comments AS comments
FROM
  stormwater.solids
  JOIN stormwater.samples ON (samples.sample_id = solids.sample_id)
  JOIN stormwater.sites ON (samples.site_id = sites.site_id)
  LEFT JOIN stormwater.data_qualifier dq ON (dq.data_qualifier_id = solids.data_qualifier)
WHERE
  sites.abbreviation NOT IN ({snaz_sites*})
;
",
.con = DBI::ANSI()
)

particulates <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, particulates_query)

particulates <- particulates |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    blank           = as.factor(ifelse(grepl("blk|blank", bottle, ignore.case = T), "TRUE", "FALSE")),
    runoff_location = as.factor(runoff_location),
    data_qualifier  = as.character(data_qualifier),
    replicate       = as.character(replicate)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-bottle)

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(particulates, overwrite = FALSE)
  capeml::write_factors(particulates, overwrite = FALSE)
})

```

## sampling_location

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: sampling-location

sampling_location_query <- glue::glue_sql("
  SELECT
    abbreviation AS location_identifier,
    site_name AS location_description,
    latitude,
    longitude
  FROM
    stormwater.sites
  WHERE
    sites.abbreviation NOT IN ({snaz_sites*})
  ;
  ",
  .con = DBI::ANSI()
)

sampling_location <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, sampling_location_query) |>
  sf::st_as_sf(
    coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
    crs    = 4326
  )

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(sampling_location, overwrite = FALSE)
})

```


## analytes

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: analytes

analytes <- DBI::dbGetQuery(pg, "
SELECT
  DISTINCT ON (analysis_name)
  analysis.analysis_name as analysis,
  analysis.analysis_description AS description,
  analysis.units,
  analysis.instrument
FROM
  stormwater.analysis
  RIGHT JOIN stormwater.results ON (results.analysis_id = analysis.analysis_id)
WHERE
  analysis.analysis_name IS NOT NULL
;
")

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(analytes, overwrite = FALSE)
})

```


## indian_bend_wash_catchments

Here we keep the source file (stormwater_catchments.geojson) in the repository
so that we can easily reconstruct indian_bend_wash_catchments when updating.

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: indian-bend-wash-catchments

# sf::st_write(
#   obj        = indian_bend_wash_catchments,
#   dsn        = "stormwater_catchments.geojson",
#   driver     = "geojson",
#   delete_dsn = TRUE
# )

# remove SNAZ sites
indian_bend_wash_catchments <- sf::read_sf("stormwater_catchments.geojson") |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !grepl(
      pattern = "bella|enc|kiw|martin|mont|pierce|sweet",
      x = catchment,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  )

# dplyr::glimpse(indian_bend_wash_catchments)

try({
  capeml::write_attributes(indian_bend_wash_catchments, overwrite = FALSE)
})

indian_bend_wash_catchments_desc <- "The location and configuration of some watersheds in the Indian Bend Wash catchment that are or have been sampled as part of the CAP LTER's research on stormwater monitoring in the greater Phoenix metropolitan area. Catchments for sampling locations along the Salt River (centralNorth, centralSouth, Ave7th) and Price have not been delineated by the CAP LTER."

indian_bend_wash_catchments_SV <- capemlGIS::create_vector(
  vector_name = indian_bend_wash_catchments,
  description = indian_bend_wash_catchments_desc
)

```


## methods

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: methods

main <- list(description = capeml::read_markdown("methods.md"))

# provenance: long-term stormwater monitoring
snaz            <- emld::as_emld(EDIutils::get_provenance_metadata("knb-lter-cap.702.2"))
snaz$`@context` <- NULL
snaz$`@type`    <- NULL

enhancedMethods <- EML::eml$methods(methodStep = list(main, snaz))

```


## coverages

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: coverages

begindate <- format(min(runoff_chemistry$runoff_datetime), "%Y-%m-%d")
enddate   <- format(max(runoff_chemistry$runoff_datetime), "%Y-%m-%d")
geo_desc  <- yaml::yaml.load_file("config.yaml")[["geographic_description"]]

coverage <- EML::set_coverage(
  begin                 = begindate,
  end                   = enddate,
  geographicDescription = geo_desc,
  west                  = sf::st_bbox(sampling_location)[["xmin"]],
  east                  = sf::st_bbox(sampling_location)[["xmax"]],
  north                 = sf::st_bbox(sampling_location)[["ymax"]],
  south                 = sf::st_bbox(sampling_location)[["ymin"]]
)

```


## literature cited

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
#| label: literature-cited

grimm_2004 <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1029/153GM11")
grimm_2005 <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1899/04-027.1")
halea      <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1021/es501039t")
haleb      <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1007/s10021-014-9812-2")
roach_2011 <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1890/10-1613.1")
roach_2008 <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1641/B580808")
walsh      <- capeml::create_citation("https://doi.org/10.1899/04-028.1")

citations <- list(
  citation = list(
    grimm_2004,
    grimm_2005,
    halea,
    haleb,
    roach_2011,
    roach_2008,
    walsh
  ) # close list of citations
) # close citation

```
